name: claude-workflows
description: Workflow and discipline skills for Claude Code: crisp (concise output), karpathy (coding discipline), handoff (session handoff notes), doc-coauthoring (structured documentation), technical-writing (ISO 24495 + Google Technical Writing rules for drafting/reviewing docs), and cs-xml-docs (C# XML doc comment conventions merged with technical-writing principles). Includes the /export-md command to export the current session to markdown via cc2md (run /install-tools once to provision cc2md).
